text:
```yaml
name: Lychee Link Checker

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Run Lychee link checker
      uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v0.3.0
      with:
        args: .
```
